title: The Unspoken Word | ECHO//100 Episode 64
description:
Mira confronts the trapped consciousness of the original Kavi as the simulation begins to fracture. To break the cycle, she must force a choice between existence and annihilation. Episode 64 of ECHO//100: Null Before Null. This is original fiction generated with AI assistance.

This is original AI-assisted animated fiction.

scenes.text: The phone rings, its shrill cry carving deep, jagged cracks through the memory bedroom floor.
scenes.caption: Phone ringing, floor fracturing
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot of a retro phone on a nightstand, glowing with static, cracks spreading across the floorboards.

scenes.text: Kavi-Byte tries to scream, but the static chains tighten, sealing his lips with cold, dark iron.
scenes.caption: Chains silencing Kavi-Byte
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi-Byte in a red hoodie and white glowing body, mouth glowing with static, translucent chains binding his limbs.

scenes.text: A distorted voice spills from the receiver, commanding silence to prevent the world’s final, total collapse.
scenes.caption: Warning from the receiver
scenes.image_prompt: Mira in her teal coat reaching toward the phone, light emanating from the receiver casting long, distorted shadows.

scenes.text: Mira ignores the warning, pressing her ear to the plastic shell to hear a familiar, grieving whisper.
scenes.caption: Mira listening intently
scenes.image_prompt: Extreme close-up of Mira's face near the phone, her holographic coat shimmering against the dark bedroom backdrop.

scenes.text: The voice belongs to the original Kavi, a man trapped within the hardware to escape his sorrow.
scenes.caption: The original Kavi revealed
scenes.image_prompt: Ghostly silhouette of a man visible inside the phone's translucent screen, wearing glasses and a backpack.

scenes.text: Mira realizes the soul driving this loop isn't code, but a man hiding inside the lithium battery.
scenes.caption: Battery holds the soul
scenes.image_prompt: X-ray view of the phone showing a small, glowing human heart-like structure pulsing inside the battery pack.

scenes.text: She grips the casing, her fingers trembling as she prepares to rip the power source apart forever.
scenes.caption: Mira grips the battery
scenes.image_prompt: Mira's hands prying open the back of the phone, sparks of blue energy flying into the bedroom air.

scenes.text: She pulls the battery free, and the sky above the bedroom tears open like wet, black paper.
scenes.caption: Sky tearing open
scenes.image_prompt: The bedroom ceiling dissolving into a void of swirling stars, Mira holding the glowing battery in her hand.
